Bug_Title: Math should not be performed on floats
Bug_Explanation: Float and double types are not precise for large numbers. Therefore, when performing mathematical operations on these types, the result may not be as expected due to precision loss. This can be addressed by using BigDecimal for large calculations, or casting to double before performing the calculation.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case compares the expected value with the float result of the addition operation. Since float has insufficient precision for large numbers, the result will not match the expected value, thus causing the test case to fail
